structured_output.summary: The change implements Promise.prototype.finally step by step as the spec describes. It checks that `this` is an Object and calls SpeciesConstructor. It passes non-callable onFinally through unchanged. Otherwise it builds thenFinally and catchFinally as builtin closures that capture onFinally and ctor, each with the right length and an empty name. Each closure does Call, PromiseResolve and Invoke(then) with `?` propagation. The valueThunk returns the captured value and the thrower throws the captured reason. All 58 target tests pass with no regressions. The five `unreachable!` lint flags guard slots that this file's own constructors always fill, and the closures are private. That makes them real invariants, so I accept them.
